title: Low-degree agreement profile
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. The low-degree agreement profile assigns to each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|S|\le k$ the number of inputs on which $f$ agrees with the Fourier character indexed by $S$, viewed as an integer from $0$ through $2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
the profile is indexed by subsets of size at most $k$
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the agreement count or Fourier character, so their precise meanings cannot be confirmed from the ground truth shown.
